reviews.text: Very nice place, with all the amenities you’ll need. I absolutely love coming here and I highly recommend it to anyone who is in need of grooming your pet here.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We had such an amazing experience at Paws 48! From the moment we arrived, we were treated with so much kindness, patience, and genuine care. I was a little nervous going in, but the owner immediately made me feel comfortable and completely at ease.

She is incredibly knowledgeable truly one of the most knowledgeable people I have ever met in the pet grooming industry.
She took the time to explain everything, answer questions, and make sure both my pet and I felt comfortable throughout the entire experience.
Her compassion, attention to detail, and thoroughness were absolutely exceptional.

I also really appreciated how thoughtfully the shop is designed.
The entire environment feels welcoming, clean, peaceful, and created with the animals’ comfort in mind.

What stood out to me most was how personal the experience felt. We weren’t treated like just another appointment we were treated like family.
That level of care means so much when you are trusting someone with an animal you love.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about our experience. If you have a pet and want someone who is knowledgeable, compassionate, professional, and truly cares about the animals she works with, this is absolutely the place to come. We had a beautiful experience and will definitely be returning.
Highly recommended! ❤️🐾

I was a little anxious about bringing my high-energy Husky to Paws 48 Dog Wash & Gym for grooming, but Angie made us both feel so comfortable from the moment we walked in! She was patient, kind, and so great with my dog. I could tell my dog was in good hands, and I left feeling completely reassured. The facility is clean, welcoming, and such a great concept for dogs. We had a wonderful experience and will definitely be coming back! Highly recommend Paws 48! ❤️🐾

Angie is absolutely wonderful! She clearly loves what she does and treats every dog with so much care and kindness. My dog looked amazing after grooming, and I could tell he felt comfortable and well cared for throughout the experience. Angie is professional, friendly, and pays attention to all the little details. I’m so grateful to have found her and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a talented and trustworthy groomer. 🐾❤️
Thanks Cheyanne! We appreciate you 🙏🏾🐶🐾 …

My dog Memphis and I Had a great experience at the Paws 48 Chandler location today. We spoke with Angie and she was very cool and thoroughly explained our dog wash and gym subscription, as well as provide a nail trim.

Memphis is normally anxious when getting a bath and having her nails trimmed, it is usually semi-traumatic for her. However this time she was very relaxed and seemed to enjoy her bath and remained relaxed for the nail trim. 🤯

Angie then provided treadmill training and again I was surprised at how quickly Memphis caught on.

Paws 48 had a very relaxing vibe and Angie has a calm energy that made for a positive experience.

Awesome place & staff!
Great way to get your dog out of the house & washed up on these hot summer days.
You can’t beat the services offered & the price for it! I highly recommend this!
Thank you Chris!!!

Visited for the first time today. Booked a self wash and was so impressed with the set up. Angie had everything I needed and more to give my boy a great wash and dry while keeping him calm, safe and smelling FRESH. Had an amazing experience with Pilot pup and we will definitely be back again soon!
Paws 48 was great for Lucas’s first time at a self wash. Calm environment great customer and pup service. Got some good grooming tips. Luca got a pup cup. We will be back.

Angie is amazing!!  I made an appointment to come in and bring two of my dogs to try out a treadmill.  Angie was very accommodating to us and got both of my pups happily trotting on the treadmill.  I will be back!!

We had a great experience, the atmosphere was amazing and we were welcomed and  assisted immediately. Its definitely the place to go if you're looking to get some exercise for your dog in a relaxing environment!
The owner was so nice and patient with my girl Ellie who is a little shy. My pup loved the treadmill and will be going back.

Professional and passionate about her profession..Angie is AWESOME!!!
Great Customer Service
Shango says 🙏🏾❤️
Happy Holidays
I love Angie she is super dope and great at what she does and my Dogghter was in love … great service i will definitely recommend…
This place is so cool. Best dog grooming salon in PHX, self baths, thread mills, AI DOG WASH 😳!!! Our pups are always treated with 5 star service! Go check them out❤️❤️ …
10/10 service! Our Loki looks amazing, thank you once again! Will be a returning customer forsure😊

Great place to wash and exercise your pet. The treadmill is the answer my dog loved it!! everything needed for washing my dog was available. Angie was a big help and very knowledgeable when it comes to caring for your pet's grooming needs. The membership gives you more bang for your bucks! Thanks Paws 48.
Joseph, thank you so much for the 5-Star review, it truly means the world to us! 🤩 …

Mr. Whiskers strutted out of here with squeaky-clean hind parts and the confidence of a runway model. This spot is a lifesaver—easy to find, stocked with everything needed to transform a scruffy fluffball into a certified baddie. The staff? Total pros—friendly, knowledgeable, and quick with tips that make bath time a breeze. Five paws up from us!

Thank you Angie a million. Got me in same day for a much needed grooming on a goldendoodle I was fostering. She is so kind and helpful I would recommend paws 48 to anyone looking for a trustworthy and efficient groomer! Can’t wait to get a pup of my own so I have a reason to come back:) before and after pics attached !

If I could give 10 stars I would.  Paws_48 has been a life saver for my Aussie's. I drove by and saw a "Dog Gym" banner early April 2025 and turned around, went in, met the owner Angie,  went home and came right back with my 2 Aussie's & signed up. We go almost every day and they walk anywhere from 30 minutes to 70 minutes.  No kidding!  Living in Phoenix Az there's no way to walk your k9 from mid June til mid September.  Having the option to do a self wash or to have them professionally groomed there is also a bonus for us. The things that separate this shop from all others is the real family feeling, the fact that the water can be warmed for k9's with arthritis and the multiple styles of blow dryer which is really important.  My female Aussie's hair is very long,  thick and fluffy.  If the dryer is too powerful it knots her fur.  My Aussie's consider Angie to be family and the shop their home away from home.  The super cool AI wash was the 1st in AZ and I know how much heart and soul is put into everything in the shop. If you have  k9 who needs extra exercise and or a relaxing bathing experience,  this is your one stop shop!

The owner is super sweet and helpful. my dog has lots of energy and the treadmills were a great way to get some of it out! the pricing is really great and the so was the experience. definitely will be bringing my pup back
So glad we took Deisy to Paws 48. Angie did a great job! Bichon Frise/poodle parents, this is the place to take your fur baby!
Angie has a great demeanor with grooming our two large breed doodles and the self wash stations make for easy washes between grooming visits.
What an incredible groomer! My dog looks and smells like a million bucks. Angie’s operation is the real deal. Will definitely be bringing my pups here going forward!
Paws48 is the BEST!!! I take my Rottweiler there to get groomed and walked the treadmill every other day!! The service is topnotch and very friendly!!!

Waited almost 40mins to get seen even tho i called ahead.

Called ahead and was told i can come in at 3pm to get a nail trim. Wasn't seen untill about 335pm. When they were finally able to get to my dog and one of the groomers was talking to me I couldn't understand half of what she was saying because the music was so loud.

When I mentioned I couldn't hear her because of the music one of the other groomers turned the music down and and a third person said "oh really?" . Like she was annoyed the music got turned down.

I won't be back.

I did however enjoy how hard the lady tried to get my dogs nails done even tho it seemed she was inexperienced and didn't have the best tools. Ended up going to petsmart and they got the over grown nails cut within ten mins.
Greg, thank you so much for the 5 star review, it means a lot! We hope to see you again soon!
Talice is so sweet and was amazing with my dog while trimming his nails. The owners (Angie & Eddie) are awesome. This is a wonderful addition to the downtown area. I can’t wait to go back!

Angie & her team were awesome. I was lucky enough to come across her business when I was looking for a nearby pet grooming salon as I just recently moved downtown Phoenix. And I spoke with Angie and she told me to come on in. They had open availability and not only was the energy great everyone was very welcoming and friendly to me and my dogs, but There was a great amount of knowledge that she gave me as well when he came to my specific dog breeds husky and Pomeranian, and which gave me quite a bit of help when it comes to their breeds. I would recommend this location to anyone and ask for Angie as you’ll always go above and beyond to help you out.

I love this place! Very kind and compassionate owners. I took my dog in for grooming and he was so happy and relaxed when I picked him up. He looked, felt and smelled amazing. I highly recommend supporting this local business.
We appreciate the awesome rating! Thanks Antonia

My buddy Maxwell smelt so good and looked amazing after his first grooming appointment at PAWS48!! Angie is the truth! Selise? I believe... did amazing as well.  They gave out a pup cup for Max and I thought that was a nice touch too.

I appreciate everyone and the good energy here! Found my new spot, and super close to downtown!
Such lovely owners!! They truly care about their clients. Thank you!!

Lucy LOVES to do her workouts, spa days, and general pampering here! The BEST family owns this paradise and they properly spoil Lucy, to the point that they are the only humans she will run away from mom for lol. 10/10 and their pricing is so low is nearly criminal! Support these wonderful people and their fantastic business!
🙏✨ Thank you so much for the 5 stars! …

Went here today for a quick dog wash and this place is awesome.  There's a bunch of doggie treadmills, which we didn't use today, but I would def come back to use.

The wash basins, which I did use are deep. My 60lb plott hound mutt was comfortably in them without being able to jump out - an issue I've had at other places. Also the non-slip mat in the bottom of the tubs is a really nice touch.  The shampoo smells awesome too without being overpowering. My dog smells clean without smelling like perfume.

I def recommend this place, especially with the hot temps coming. It's such a cute idea and a great way to keep dogs active when it's too hot to walk them.

The owner even gave my dog a little treat after :)

I went with my pups to get them their much needed baths. They provided everything we needed and more to get our babies looking nice and fresh. The staff is super sweet and accommodating, we look forward to being back!
I love it here! Very clean, inviting and refreshing!

Shadow loves Paws 48! The owner, Angie, is always so kind and helpful. Our dog has grown to love bath time, and is even learning to use the treadmills. We love that this spot is close to our neighborhood and is a great way to get her exercise indoors when it's too hot to go outside.

Angie the owner is super patient with my 2 chugs we got them up and going on the treadmill the first time! So excited we’re definitely getting memberships thank you to the Paws 48 team yall are awesome!
I brought my German shepherd to get groomed and Angie handled him so well. He’s usually a mess and super fun but nonetheless very messy so thank you Angie for getting him ready for our weekend.
Omg this place is so cool!!! Everyone is super friendly here, me and my boys will be back soon!!!
I was nervous to take my 2 anxious pups for a little treadmill time, but Angela was SO helpful!! My dogs picked it up right away! I bought a gym membership for my pups. Would recommend!!
Love a small local shop. Especially for my pup, thank you for being so nice & having a very clean relaxing place. Definitely making a stop here regularly.

My pup Tilly had her first test drive on the doggy treadmill and with some encouragement took her first run. The owner was wonderful and helped Tilly walk through her first time❤️

The owner is amazing and so kind to everyone who walks through those front doors. Love having community businesses like this.
